$comment: No $id on purpose: Test-Json resolves relative references only without an absolute $id, and every Rulebook schema follows the same rule.
title: Rulebook overrides
description: overrides.json of an organization rulebook repository: rule changes with level and stage selectors. Selectors are non-empty arrays of lowercase slugs or ["*"]; whether a slug exists in the settings is validation check C10. See docs/reference/naming.md.

diagnosticId.description: A diagnostic id: two or three capital letters, four digits, an optional lowercase i (PTE0011, AL0432, LC0089i).

ruleAction.description: A rule action. Default is not valid for a rule.

slug.description: A level or stage slug: the lowercased name from the settings.

selector.description: ["*"] for every level or stage, or a non-empty list of distinct slugs. Arrays only; "default" is a valid stage slug.

justification.description: Why the organization overrides this rule. Optional (D37).
